items.title: Ella Langley sweeps Country Music Awards as Taylor Swift returns for 1st performance in 13 years
chats: Did you catch the CMAs last night? Ella Langley swept the whole thing.
Choosin Texas is everywhere, so I'm not even surprised.
And Taylor Swift performed at the CMAs for the first time in 13 years!
Six awards for Ella Langley in one night, that's a record apparently.
Wow, that song really earned it. It's been stuck in my head for weeks.
Same here, I hum it every time I'm stuck at a red light.
Still thinking about that CMA sweep honestly.
I'm putting Choosin Texas on for the drive home tonight.
Turn it up loud, it's a ladies night kind of playlist.

items.title: Taylor Swift Has Surprise Guest for First CMAs Performance in 13 Years
chats: Okay, did you hear Taylor Swift brought a surprise guest to the CMAs?
No way, she hadn't performed there in years, right?
Thirteen years! Country fans must have lost their minds.
Have you seen the clips of Taylor at the CMAs yet?
Not yet, but people are already hunting for Easter eggs.
Of course they are, she always hides little clues in everything.
I watched the Taylor CMA performance on my break.
Was it worth the hype?
Totally. I'm rewatching it tonight with a cup of tea.

items.title: ‘GTA 6’ Launch Breaks Internet Usage Records; Livestreams Hit Nearly 8 Million Views on Twitch, YouTube and More in First Hours of Release
chats: Apparently GTA 6 launch broke internet usage records last night.
I believe it. My nephew has been counting down for ages.
Nearly 8 million people watched livestreams in the first few hours!
CBC says loads of people are taking days off to play GTA 6.
Ha, I guess the IT help desk is on hold everywhere this week.
HR experts say it happens with big releases all the time.
Is the internet still holding up after the GTA 6 rush?
So far so good on my end, emails are loading at least.
Good, I'd hate to lose my streaming tonight to a video game.

items.title: Nathan Fielder lookalike contest crowns a deadpan winner
chats: Did you see Toronto held a Nathan Fielder lookalike contest?
Ha, that's amazing. What did they even have to do?
Business pitches, a staring contest, and an improv chat with a fake Elizabeth Holmes.
That Nathan Fielder lookalike contest crowned a deadpan winner.
Honestly deadpan is the whole job, so that's perfect.
I'd lose the staring contest in about two seconds.
Still laughing about the Nathan Fielder lookalike thing.
I want to see photos of all the contestants.
I'm looking them up tonight, the deadpan faces must be gold.

items.title: ‘Gilmore Girls: A Day In The Life’ Gets New Home On Hulu After Netflix Deal Ends, Release Date Set
chats: Okay, Gilmore Girls is moving to Hulu and Disney+ soon.
Wait, the whole collection in one place again?
Yep, the revival lands there ten years after its Netflix Christmas debut.
Have you ever watched the Gilmore Girls revival?
Once, years ago. Might be time for a cozy rewatch.
Perfect fireplace weather for it too.
Gilmore Girls marathon this winter, who's in?
Me, with hot cocoa and a blanket.
Sounds like the coziest plan of the season.

items.title: Glen Powell Joined By Nashville’s Biggest Stars in Raucous Trailer For Country Comedy ‘The Comeback King’: Watch
chats: Did you see the trailer for Glen Powell's country comedy The Comeback King?
Yes! Judd Apatow directed it, right?
And Reba, Jelly Roll and Miranda Lambert all pop up in it.
The Comeback King trailer looks so rowdy and fun.
Glen Powell in a country comedy feels like a perfect fit.
I'm calling it now, this one's going to be a big hit.
I rewatched The Comeback King trailer just for the Reba cameo.
Reba makes everything better.
Adding it to my must watch list right now.

items.title: P!nk Adds 2028 Dates to Sphere Residency Due to Huge Demand: ‘This Is Crazy’
chats: Apparently P!nk added more Sphere dates because of huge demand.
How huge are we talking?
She said three million people were in line for tickets.
Six new P!nk shows at the Sphere, now going into 2028.
Seeing her fly around that place would be wild.
She even said it herself, this is crazy.
Three million people in a ticket queue, still can't get over it.
That's bigger than a lot of cities.
I'm putting on Trustfall for the drive home.

items.title: John Summit Brings Squishmallows to the Club With New Collab: ‘A Dream Come True’
chats: Did you hear John Summit made a Squishmallows collab?
The DJ? With the squishy toys? That's adorable.
He called it a dream come true, and it starts their artist series.
Squishmallows for the club crowd, I did not see that coming.
Honestly I'd buy one just for the couch.
Limited edition too, so fans will snap them up fast.
Still smiling about the DJ Squishmallow thing.
Might grab one as a stocking stuffer.
Great idea, way more fun than socks.

items.title: The Hilarious Reason Channing Tatum Is “Useless” to Daughter Everly
chats: Did you see why Channing Tatum says he's useless to his daughter?
Ha, what happened?
Turns out he can't step up as her dance teacher.
Channing Tatum not being able to teach dance is so funny.
Right? You'd think he'd be the first pick.
Kids always keep their parents humble.
Still giggling about Channing Tatum the useless dance dad.
I'm going to rewatch a dance movie of his tonight.
Good call, proof he still has the moves.

items.title: Dakota Johnson Is 50 Shades Sleeker With "Off Black" Hair Makeover
chats: Have you seen Dakota Johnson's new off black hair?
She went dark? I loved her blonde.
She said goodbye to the dirty blonde, very sleek now.
Dakota Johnson's off black hair is kind of a whole new look.
I think it suits her really well.
Winter hair change, I totally get the urge.
Still thinking about Dakota Johnson's darker hair.
Inspiring me to book a trim.
Go for it, new season, new look.
